# Independent audit: fiber-difference depth-transfer obstruction

Source: `candidate 1afce146f321da9d`.


an OC counterexample.

For any nonnegative barycentric coefficients, the Minkowski sum of
the centered differences is exactly the centered difference of the
Minkowski sum. Actual anchored containment therefore survives this
fiberwise symmetrization. No equality of centroids is presumed.

For the actual interval family [0,1],[0,3],[0,1] above bases -1,0,1,
the convex hull has precisely these three integer fibers and mixed
length five. At an endpoint base a finite integer tilt isolates that
fiber and selects its shorter tail, giving raw depth at most one half.
At the middle base, y>=1 has upward cap of mass 3-y<=2, while
0<=y<=1 has a tilted downward cap of exact mass 1+y<=2.

At (0,1), every upward cap through the point captures middle mass two.
Every downward cap captures middle mass one and at least one whole
endpoint interval, because its two endpoint thresholds sum to two.
Pure-base caps capture the entire middle fiber. Moving any containing
halfspace boundary to the point only removes mass. Thus all ambient
orientations have mass at least two, and the normalized maximum is
exactly 2/5. The boundary-only endpoint traces in the upper cap at
y=1 have length zero and cause no missing mass.

The centered differences have radii 1/2,3/2,1/2 and their mixed measure
is centrally symmetric in the full (base,continuous) space. Every
closed halfspace through zero captures at least half the measure;
the horizontal continuous cut has exactly half. At every other point,
a hyperplane with nonzero continuous normal has zero mixed boundary
measure, and one of its two containing closed sides has at most half.
Therefore the maximum is exactly 1/2, including the possibility of
positive boundary mass for pure-base cuts.

The product extension uses a centered symmetric volume-one body in
the extra continuous coordinates. It preserves every fiber volume,
compatibility, and each displayed original upper cap. The difference
family is centrally symmetric. Finally Gamma_2=4/9, Gamma_3=27/64,
Gamma_4=256/625 and Gamma_5=3125/7776 are all strictly greater than 2/5.
Thus the claimed transfer also fails through dimension five, without
needing an exact formula for the original product depth.

No scope or constant repair identified.
